en: Vintage-style printed view of a European city square with a tall Marian or victory column at its center, surrounded by Baroque and classicist buildings. Market stalls line the left side, and people in 18th–19th century clothing walk across the cobbled square. A horse‑drawn carriage and riders move along the streets. The right side features a large, ornate palace-like building with many windows and a central arched portal. The image is monochrome and appears as an old engraving reproduced on a postcard. No legible text is visible on the front.
